transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's my right knee — it's been aching for a while but it's got a lot worse over the last couple of months. It's getting in the way of walking the dog now.
When did you first notice it?
It's been aching on and off for about 3 years, but it's got noticeably worse over the last 2 months.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
It's worse going down stairs, and after I've been walking for more than about 10 minutes. It eases off when I rest it, and paracetamol helps.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's a deep, grinding sort of ache. And it feels stiff in the mornings — takes about 20 minutes to loosen up.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's on the inner side of the right knee. No, it doesn't spread down the leg.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
On a bad day it's about a 7 out of 10. I can't manage walking the dog round the park any more.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
It comes and goes — it's been on and off for about 3 years. But lately, on the bad days, it's a lot more constant.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
The knee sometimes swells up a bit by the evening. I've not had any redness, and no fever or locking.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes — I've had type 2 diabetes for about 10 years, and I had a stent put in a heart artery 6 years ago.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I take metformin, 1 gram twice a day. Aspirin 75 mg once a day. Atorvastatin 40 mg at night. And ramipril 5 mg once a day. Nothing new.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
Yes, penicillin gives me a rash.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
Yes — I have to go down the stairs one step at a time now, holding the rail.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
I'd like something stronger for the pain, because what I'm taking isn't cutting it. And I've been wondering — do you think I might need a knee replacement?
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
